name: factory_arm_agent
description: Tier 2 escalation agent for the factory robot arm project. Given a fault that isn't on the Tier 1 auto-recovery whitelist, assesses whether it can be confidently handled and, if so, proposes one action from a declared catalog via OpenAI. Posts the proposal to Slack and waits for a reply before returning; a rejection retries once with that feedback folded in, then escalates. Never executes anything itself — the calling system's own Guard independently re-verifies and executes whatever this agent returns.

triggers.name: fault
triggers.description: The fault as detected: {fault_type, safetystatus, robotmode}.

triggers.name: live_status
triggers.description: A freshly re-checked live status snapshot: {safetystatus, robotmode}. Omit if not available.

triggers.name: fault_duration_seconds
triggers.description: How long the fault has been ongoing, in seconds, per the safety monitor. Omit if not yet known.

triggers.name: recent_history
triggers.description: Last few audit log entries for this same fault_type, so the agent can see whether this was already tried and what happened.
